m: enas (as), n. (√ i, Uṇ. iv, 197; √ in, BRD.), mischief, crime, sin, offence, fault, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; Mn. &c.
evil, unhappiness, misfortune, calamity, RV.; AV.
a: enas n. [i-asun nuṭ Uṇ. 4. 197] 1 Sin, offence, fault; ātmaghātina enasā saṃyujyate K. 174; Śi. 14. 35; 16. 8. 2 Mischief, crime. 3 Unhappiness. 4 Censure, blame.
